name: The Leviathan Road
descriptionSeed: The migration road of the great leviathans across the world ocean, and the people who follow them: riders who live on the backs of beasts the size of towns, and come to land only to trade and to fight.
encounterFlavor: leviathan-riders, merfolk outriders, and the very brave
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: pinned at the LANDING where a traveller reaches them, which is also the region's seat on land. The riders come ashore here when their leviathans rest; the Road itself is out on the open ocean.
appearance: A line of vast backs breaking the ocean surface, huts and harness-rigging on them, and riders standing on the swell as if it were a road.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
